title: (RHEA-2023:0155) OpenShift Virtualization 4.11.2 Images
portal_summary: Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization release 4.11.2 is now available with updates to packages and images that fix several bugs and add enhancements.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Container Native Virtualization|Red Hat Container Native Virtualization|4.11|x86_64
Red Hat Container Native Virtualization|Red Hat Container Native Virtualization|4.11|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, confirm that all previously released errata
relevant to your system are applied.

For details about how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
